title: Taking Regular Breaks at Work
paragraphs: Working long hours at his desk without pause, Zain began experiencing frequent headaches and neck pain by the middle of most workdays, a pattern he assumed was simply unavoidable given his job.
A company health talk introduced him to a simple habit: standing up and stretching for five minutes every hour, something he initially dismissed as unnecessary given his busy schedule.
After reluctantly trying it for one week, Zain noticed his headaches occurred far less often, and he felt noticeably more alert during the afternoon, when he usually struggled most with focus.
He now sets a quiet reminder on his phone every hour, using the short break to walk to the window, refill his water bottle, or simply stretch his back and shoulders.
Zain tells his colleagues that this small change cost him almost nothing in time, yet gave him back energy he had assumed was simply lost to the demands of his job.
